mapper.select:
select distinct ur.UserId,ur.RoleId,r.RoleName,us.XM as Name,r.GROUPBY,r.ORDERBY,r.DICTIONARYID,p.DZZMC from VM_RYJBXX us -- 视图 inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX p on us.szdzbdm=p.dzzdm -- 党组织信息 inner join CF_USERS ui on ui.USERID=us.RYBM inner join cf_userroles ur on ur.UserId=ui.USERID inner join CF_ROLES r on r.RoleId=ur.RoleId where ur.RoleId=#{roleId}
and us.XM like concat('%',#{username},'%')
select r.GROUPBY,max(r.orderby) orderby from CF_USERROLES us inner join CF_ROLES r on us.ROLEID=r.ROLEID where us.USERID=#{userId} group by r.GROUPBY
select * from CF_USERROLES us inner join CF_ROLES r on us.ROLEID=r.ROLEID where us.USERID=#{userId} and r.ROLENAME=#{roleName}

SELECT u.USERID,ur.ROLEID,r.ROLENAME FROM CF_USERS u left join CF_USERROLES ur on u.USERID = ur.USERID left join CF_ROLES r on ur.ROLEID = r.ROLEID WHERE u.USERNAME = #{userName} and ur.ROLEID is not null
mapper.insert: insert into CF_USERROLES (ROLEID, USERID) values (#{roleId}, (SELECT USERID FROM CF_USERS WHERE CF_USERS.USERNAME = #{userName}))
